f.title: Include the 'Limited Population' statement in all labeling and advertising of LPAD antibacterial/antifungal drugs
f.statement: All labeling and advertising of an antibacterial or antifungal drug approved under the limited population pathway shall contain the statement 'Limited Population'.
f.clause: Sec. 3042, FD&C Act sec. 506(h)(3)(A)(i) Limited population pathway - additional requirements - labeling
f.applicability: Antibacterial or antifungal drugs approved under the limited population pathway (FD&C Act sec. 506(h))
f.exceptions: If FDA later approves a broader indication under FD&C Act sec. 505(b) or PHS Act sec. 351(a), FDA may remove these postmarketing conditions (sec. 506(h)(7)).

f.title: Place the 'Limited Population' statement adjacent to, and not more prominent than, the drug's proprietary or established/proper name
f.statement: In the labeling and advertising of an antibacterial or antifungal drug approved under the limited population pathway, the 'Limited Population' statement is to be placed adjacent to, and not more prominent than, (I) the proprietary name of the drug, if any, or (II) if there is no proprietary name, the established name of the drug, if any, as defined in sec. 503(e)(3), or, for a biological product, the proper name as defined by regulation.
f.clause: Sec. 3042, FD&C Act sec. 506(h)(3)(A)(i)(I)-(II) Limited population pathway - additional requirements - labeling
f.applicability: Antibacterial or antifungal drugs approved under the limited population pathway (FD&C Act sec. 506(h))
f.exceptions: If FDA later approves a broader indication under FD&C Act sec. 505(b) or PHS Act sec. 351(a), FDA may remove these postmarketing conditions (sec. 506(h)(7)).

f.title: Include the limited-population indication statement in the prescribing information of LPAD drugs
f.statement: The prescribing information for a drug approved under the limited population pathway, required by 21 CFR 201.57 (or any successor regulation), shall also include the statement: 'This drug is indicated for use in a limited and specific population of patients.'
f.clause: Sec. 3042, FD&C Act sec. 506(h)(3)(A)(ii) Limited population pathway - additional requirements - labeling
f.applicability: Antibacterial or antifungal drugs approved under the limited population pathway (FD&C Act sec. 506(h))
f.exceptions: If FDA later approves a broader indication under FD&C Act sec. 505(b) or PHS Act sec. 351(a), FDA may remove these postmarketing conditions (sec. 506(h)(7)).

f.title: Submit all LPAD promotional materials to FDA at least 30 calendar days before dissemination
f.statement: The sponsor of an antibacterial or antifungal drug approved under the limited population pathway shall submit to FDA (the Secretary) copies of all promotional materials related to the drug at least 30 calendar days prior to dissemination of the materials.
f.clause: Sec. 3042, FD&C Act sec. 506(h)(3)(B) Limited population pathway - additional requirements - promotional material
f.applicability: Antibacterial or antifungal drugs approved under the limited population pathway (FD&C Act sec. 506(h))
f.exceptions: If FDA later approves a broader indication under FD&C Act sec. 505(b) or PHS Act sec. 351(a), FDA may remove these postmarketing conditions (sec. 506(h)(7)).
